lastChange: US prices rose $2 per plan, announced 2 February 2026, for existing members from their first bill after 4 March 2026 (Fan's first US rise since 2019).

Fan.manga: Add-on in the US and Canada

free: Crunchyroll's free, ad-supported tier ended on 31 December 2025 in every market reported (US, Brazil, India, Pakistan, Nigeria). A free account can browse but not watch; nothing on demand is free, first episodes included. Still free: the 7-day trial, Crunchyroll's YouTube channels and its 24/7 ad-supported TV channel on services such as Samsung TV Plus.
trial: 7 days on any plan, for new or eligible accounts only, once per person. A payment method is needed, it renews automatically unless cancelled, and cancelling during the trial ends access straight away.
manga: Crunchyroll Manga is a separate reading app (and web reader) on the same account, with 450+ titles in English in the US and Canada (250+ at launch in India and the other newer markets). It launched in the US and Canada on 9 October 2025 and reached the UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and India on 8 October 2026. Ultimate Fan includes it; on other plans it's a paid add-on (in the US, $4 a month on Fan or $3.50 on Mega Fan; which plans can add it varies by country). In India it comes only with Ultimate Fan.
gameVault: About 100 premium mobile games with no ads or in-app purchases, included with Mega Fan and Ultimate Fan (not Fan) since November 2023.
